card.title: Every Compliment Raises the Bar
card.instruction: Treat each compliment as sincere admiration and a new standard you must immediately surpass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said I handled the meeting well. I'll improve tomorrow's agenda before lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your summary was excellent. Come get a sandwich with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll make tomorrow's half as long, with clearer decisions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're brilliant at making things simple. Explain the budget to me over lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. If simple is my standard, I'll get the whole budget onto your napkin before the sandwiches arrive.

mechanism: A accepts praise of communication as a new bar and immediately promises a more exacting demonstration.
confusable: Unlike habitual overwork alone, each higher demand must arise from B's actual admiring description.
comparison: S229-b turns simple into a napkin budget before sandwiches; S229-a turns beautiful into a more elaborate boxed rose.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
